remarks: Charming, Well-Maintained Cape in a Prime Walk-to-Everything Location  This beautifully maintained 1,784 sq. ft. Cape offers comfort, convenience, and thoughtful updates throughout. Ideally located within walking distance to the train, shopping, and schools, this home combines classic charm with modern amenities.  Features include a spacious eat-in kitchen, updated baths, a formal dining room, and a welcoming living room with a fireplace. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, a finished lower level offering flexible living space, and a screened-in porch overlooking the fully fenced backyard-perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  A wonderful opportunity to enjoy a move-in-ready home in a highly convenient neighborhood.
